method.reference: constant speed independently between interpolated same-phase crossings of every revolution
method.turn_aggregation: node-wise median after per-turn DC removal
method.coherence_rule: harmonics 1..16: phase cosine >= 0.5 and amplitude ratio >= 0.25
method.correction_units: signed centidegrees; cyclic linear interpolation every 32 raw counts
method.curve_coordinates: error curves use ideal angle; correction LUT uses measured/raw angle

limitations: Sin una referencia angular externa, la curva coherente puede incluir ondulación mecánica o de velocidad, además del encoder/imán.
